scope: Apply twenty FreeCAD candidate importer patches to a clean disposable checkout, with ordinary-failure rollback and retry.
checks: Applied all twenty patches to a clean disposable Git worktree and matched the five files against the independent archive replay.
A checkout with tracked modifications was refused before application.
Injected an error at the fifth patch check after four earlier patches; byte snapshots were restored, Git status was clean, and an uninjected retry applied all twenty patches and matched replay.
finding: Reversing zero-context patches did not preserve the original header line endings byte-for-byte. The implementation restores saved original bytes on ordinary failure and checks them after restoration.
limitations: The checkout must be disposable and not modified concurrently. Abrupt termination and I/O failures can prevent complete recovery; incomplete restoration is reported.
Ignored files and submodule content are not verified.
Only macOS was tested; Linux and Windows build and runtime qualification remains open.
Source replay and application are not independent semantic or GUI evidence.
